subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Know how an email starts, ends and is organised.
Write an email about a school trip with going to and the present simple.
Add adjectives and check an email with a checklist.

tf.s: A school trip email often starts with Dear students.
tf.why: Yes, Dear … is a polite start.

tf.s: The subject box tells the reader the topic of the email.
tf.why: Yes, the subject shows what it is about.

tf.s: A school trip email is organised in paragraphs by day.
tf.why: Yes, this makes the plan clear.

tf.s: We end a formal email with See ya!
tf.why: We end with Yours and the writer's name.

tf.s: Adjectives like amazing and delicious make an email more interesting.
Yours goes at the start of an email.
tf.why: Yours goes at the end, before the name.

tf.s: We use going to for the trip plans: We're going to visit Jabreen Castle.
tf.why: Yes, going to is for plans.

tf.s: Timetable details like The coach leaves at 7 a.m. use the past simple.
A school trip email can include a time for each activity.
tf.why: Yes, times make the plan clear.

boxes.q: Complete: We're going to travel by ___ rocket to the Moon.
Complete: Bring a ___ suitcase because the rocket isn't very big!
boxes.why: A small rocket needs small bags.

boxes.q: How does the Moon email end?
Which is a good subject line?
boxes.why: The subject gives the topic in a few words.

boxes.q: Add an adjective: We're going to see ___ views.
Which goes at the very start of the email message?
o: We look forward to seeing you.

boxes.q: Which is a good last line before Yours?
o: We look forward to seeing you soon.

boxes.why: Heavy things are hard to carry.

mcq.q: What do you write in the To box?
mcq.why: To shows who gets the email.

mcq.q: Which list shows the right order of an email?
Which adjectives are from the lesson?
mcq.why: These adjectives can describe a trip.

mcq.q: Which items are on the email checklist?
o: To, Subject, Dear, days, times, adjectives, ending
mcq.why: The checklist covers all email parts.

mcq.q: Write a going to sentence for the trip.
o: We're going to visit Jabreen Castle.
We going to visit Jabreen Castle.
We're go to visit Jabreen Castle.

mcq.q: Which is the best first line of a school trip email?
o: Dear students, We can now send you information about our school trip.
mcq.why: It greets and introduces the topic.

mcq.q: Choose the right adjective: Wahiba Sands has ___ sand dunes.
Why is the Moon email organised by days?
o: To make the plan clear and easy to follow.

mcq.q: Is a school trip email formal or informal? How do you know?
o: Quite formal – it starts with Dear and ends with Yours.
mcq.why: Dear … and Yours show a formal email.

mcq.q: A partner's email has no times for each day. What is the best wish?
o: Next time, add a time for each activity.
